text: **A FIELD THE TOOL REFUSES TO PROCEED WITHOUT MUST REACH A HUMAN READ FACE -- AND RENDERING IT IS NOT ENOUGH.** (ic 2026-08-18 by round-trip; widened by cc, who verified structurally and independently.) `Thread.status_reason` is MANDATORY on `cancel`, `hold`, `reopen` and `reinstate`, and the refusal argues for it verbatim -- _"recorded on the entity as the reason for its CURRENT state, and in the event log as part of the decision, **which is what lets anyone reconstruct why later**"_. **A planted canary reason survives into `thread.json` and appears in NEITHER `st show`, NOR `st list --status all`, NOR the rendered `info.md`; there are ZERO occurrences in `render.rs` and `views.rs`.** **THE PROMISE NAMES TWO CARRIERS AND HAS A READER ON NEITHER: `intent --help` declares 34 verbs and NOT ONE READS THE EVENT LOG** -- no `events`, no `log`, no `history` -- **and `search` does not reach it either, since `ingest.rs` never mentions the field, so _full-text search across all authored prose_ excludes this authored prose.** **SO THIS ROW IS NOT SATISFIED BY RENDERING THE FIELD.** `event_log_envelopes.rs:168` records that the envelope holds the HISTORY while the field carries only the LATEST reason, so showing the field answers _why is it on hold NOW_ and never _reconstruct why later_ -- **a fix to the visible half would make the promise LOOK kept while leaving it unkept.** It closes when the promised reconstruction is reachable, or when the refusal stops promising it. **This is a harder loss than a dropped rendering distinction: it is AUTHORED PROSE a human typed because the tool demanded it, recoverable only from the committed machine extract.** **BOUNDED on ic's own statement of reach: established for CLI READ FACES and MARKDOWN VIEWS. `Thread` derives `Serialize` and `SimpleObject`, so a GraphQL face was not reached -- the claim is _no human face_, not _no face_.**
